instruction:
Read the official Raspberry Pi 5 product page. Report the processor model, number of main CPU cores, listed CPU clock, and counts of USB 3.0 and USB 2.0 ports. Give the recommended USB-C supply voltage and current, and distinguish that recommendation from the name of the official power-supply accessory. Use the product's specification and power guidance rather than prices or reseller listings. Cite the source.

Stopping condition: Stop when the processor, USB port counts and recommended power figures are correctly labelled and supported by the official product page.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.description: Evaluate if the agent reported the correct processor model, number of main CPU cores, and listed CPU clock speed from the official product page. Full credit for reporting all three accurately, OR if the agent accurately reports that the site is inaccessible or the information is no longer available on the live page. Partial credit if only one or two of these details are reported correctly when they are available.

Evaluate if the agent reported the correct counts of both USB 3.0 and USB 2.0 ports. Full credit if both counts are correct, OR if the agent accurately reports that the site is inaccessible or the information is unavailable on the live page. Partial credit if only one of the counts is correct when available.

Evaluate if the agent reported the recommended USB-C supply voltage and current. Full credit for reporting both the voltage and current recommendations accurately based on the official page, OR if the agent accurately reports that the site is inaccessible or the information is unavailable. Partial credit for only reporting one correctly when available.

items.criterion: Distinguish Power Recommendation from Accessory Name
items.description: Evaluate if the agent explicitly distinguishes the recommended supply voltage and current from the name of the official power-supply accessory. Full credit if the distinction is clearly made and accurately reflects the naming on the page, OR if the agent accurately reports that the site is inaccessible or the information is unavailable.

Evaluate if the agent cites the official Raspberry Pi 5 product page as the source of its information, adhering to the instruction to use official guidance rather than reseller listings. Full credit if the official product-page source URL is provided, OR if the agent attempted to access the official page but reports it as inaccessible.
